Change Controls now with additional functionalities

Added Credits.txt to the Bundle
Bug fixes

notes.title: Release Date Changed
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

thank you so much for downloading the Gundroid Demo and the feedback i got from you, i really appreciate it!

I am making good progress on the game, but there are still things i would like to add and i need some additional time for fine-tuning,  balancing and bug fixing. Unfortunately the release date i was aiming for in Q4 will not hold, so i have to postpone the launch for a couple of months to make sure i am happy with the game without rushing it. I really hope you will enjoy the final game, i definitely had a lot of fun making it!

Thank you again for your support, i am really excited for the release!
